invariants: event_seq is strictly increasing per candidate process
each request_id denotes exactly one control request
each command_id may have repeated attempts but at most one mutation and one distinct completed result
retryable_rejection occurs before acceptance and performs no mutation
accepted commands always receive exactly one terminal result before teardown or rollout completion
counter and sequence are monotonic within one generation; crash recovery may reset both only when generation increments
completed update-window increments survive success or rollback
candidate rollout status is not external success until the oracle completes three confirmation snapshots
all latency clocks and resource samples are owned by the external oracle
